summary: This note summarizes the permitted hours for selling alcohol in Maine. Alcohol may be sold between 5am and 1am every day of the week. On New Year's Day, the sale window is extended until 2 a.m.
one_line: Summary of Maine's legal hours for selling alcohol, including the extended New Year's Day window.
key_facts: Alcohol may be sold in Maine between the hours of 5am and 1am each day of the week.
On New Year's Day, alcohol may be sold in Maine until 2 a.m.
The note covers the alcohol laws of Maine.
The note's source is listed as Wikipedia.
